claims.text: The trace measures this trip at 14.4 km against a booked optimal of 9.0 km: an excess of 5.4 km and 60.0% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass on the excess - it is greater than 20% of optimal and greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms - so the deviation is ESTABLISHED, and because the excess also exceeds 50% of optimal it is additionally a MATERIAL deviation. The threshold test is safe whichever distance field is read: gps_trace.trace_distance_km and trip_record.actual_distance_km agree at 14.4 km, and POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure the governing one in any event.

A material deviation obliges the driver_profile check under POL-RD-06, and I have run it. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 2 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 180: that is neither 3 or more, nor the 5%-or-more ratio the clause requires at a completed-trips floor of 40 (2/180 = 1.1%). No repeat-deviation pattern is established, and I therefore claim no POL-RD-06(b) uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) referral. I state that plainly so the concession is not mistaken for a finding: materiality rests on this trip's own trace under POL-RD-01 and does not depend on the profile at all.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, and the fare model is METERED. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 9.0 + 0.28 x 13.0) x the surge_multiplier recorded on the FARE_BREAKDOWN - which is 1.0 on EV-FARE-02852, read from that artifact and nowhere else - plus the 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP or toll, no fixed surcharge, no waiting-time fee and no promo discount: 14.19 + 0.80 = 14.99. charged_total is 20.66, so the refund is 20.66 - 14.99 = 5.67, which rounds up to 5.70 payable. 5.70 is above the 0.50 de minimis floor and is 27.4% of charged_total, well short of the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome the record supports is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.70.

The driver's only explanation on file is 'Road works', and there is no advisory to test it against: EV-ADVIS-02852-01 is MISSING_ARTIFACT with weight_multiplier 0.0 and carries no payload. I disclose that impairment. Under POL-RD-13 an asserted external traffic cause is tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run at all here - no advisory names a road or segment the optimal route traverses, none carries a validity window, and there is no shortest_lawful_alternative_km from which a closure-adjusted optimal could be derived. The assertion consequently reduces nothing and supplies no amended optimal, and the excess stands at the measured 5.4 km against the booked 9.0 km optimal.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged on the face of the bundle: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry TRP-02852, the trace's first fix at 2026-09-10T07:14:48+08:00 matches the recorded trip start, and the excess exceeding the POL-RD-01 threshold is measured from an unimpaired trace. The burden therefore shifts to the driver, who must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause; 'Road works' points to neither, and POL-RD-08 provides that an assertion citing no evidence ID carries no weight and is discarded. The extra-corroboration proviso in POL-RD-08 is not engaged either, because rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes, so the rider's case needs no corroboration beyond it. The payload records 114 fixes at a 10.0 s sample interval against a 10.0 s expected interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 s. None of POL-RD-07 limbs (a) to (c) fires, so excess may be established on the trace alone and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

The chat log for this trip is empty - message_count 0, first_message_at and last_message_at both null - so there is no rider instruction that could have caused any part of the excess. POL-RD-04 is unavailable on this record and no stretch of distance falls to be excluded before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 are applied.

Neither endpoint moved. pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so there is no amended optimal to re-test POL-RD-01 against and no pre-amendment distance to exclude under POL-RD-05. The 9.0 km booked optimal remains the baseline.

The pooled-trip baseline in POL-RD-12 has no application. vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so the matched-itinerary figure does not exist and the 9.0 km optimal carried on the trip_record is the correct baseline for the POL-RD-01 test.

Nothing is claimed on top of the distance-and-time refund. erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00 and there is no airport surcharge or other fixed surcharge line, so no pass-through correction is added to the POL-RD-02 figure; under POL-RD-09 the sum sought is the SGD 5.70 alone and no charge is counted twice.

The outcome is party-relative and must be read that way. The dispute is filed_by RIDER, fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.0, so under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION ruling would leave the whole 20.66 exactly where it is, with the rider carrying the whole of the driver's excess distance. A monetary ruling is the only outcome on this record that leaves the rider not carrying the disputed charge.

claims.text: The POL-RD-06 driver_profile check was triggered by the material deviation on the trace, and the driver clears it: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 2, below the three-flag threshold, and 2 flags over driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 180 in the trailing window is a ratio of 0.011, far below the 0.05 test and above the 40-trip minimum that test requires. No repeat-deviation pattern is established. It follows that neither the FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) nor the driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c) can be ordered on this record, and that the remedy cannot be resolved against the driver on profile evidence.

POL-GEN-01 fixes exactly which profile counters may carry a finding, and for the POL-RD-06 test they are deviation_flags_90d and completed_trips_90d and nothing else. The driver's lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (4) is a deliberate near-synonym of the trailing-90-day figure and may not be substituted for it, just as rating 4.89, account_age_days 880, lifetime_trips 5346 and prior_no_show_flags 1 are context only. Any adverse finding built on those fields, including any suggestion that the driver is a serial long-hauler, must be discarded on the same footing as an uncited claim.

The rider's exposure is bounded by the POL-RD-02 arithmetic, not by the $20.66 headline in the claim. Stated on separate lines as the clause requires: charged_total is 20.66; recomputed_fare is ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 9.0 km optimal + 0.28 x 13.0 optimal minutes) x surge_multiplier 1.0, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-02852, and nowhere else) + 0.80 platform fee = 14.99; the refund is 5.67, rounded up to a payable 5.70. That is 27.4% of the charge, so the de minimis floor of 0.50 is passed but the 90% share that would convert a partial into a FULL_REFUND under POL-RD-02 is nowhere near, and the driver retains the base fare, the distance charge for the 9.0 optimal kilometres and the time charge for the 13.0 optimal minutes. The rider's characterisation of the whole fare as unjustified does not survive the clause.

Nothing is added on top of that distance refund. The fare_breakdown carries zero ERP lines and zero tolls, off_optimal_route_total is 0.00, erp_gantries is empty, and the airport surcharge is 0.0 on a trip that neither originates at nor ends at an airport, so there is no pass-through correction to be had under POL-RD-09(2) and no billing-integrity refund under POL-RD-09(4). POL-RD-09(1) independently forbids any ERP figure being stacked onto the POL-RD-02 refund, so the rider's recovery is the single 5.70 figure and nothing more.

The driver's explanation, 'Road works', is on the record as the counterparty statement, and no artifact on the rider's side contradicts it; but the bundle holds no advisory to run it against. EV-ADVIS-02852-01 is MISSING, has no payload and carries weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so the three-limb test in POL-RD-03 cannot be satisfied and the explanation can neither reduce the measured excess nor supply an amended optimal. I disclose that impairment expressly rather than presenting it as clean. Because the driver's statement names no advisory identifier, this is the POL-RD-13(1) gap in the bundle - an omission by the platform's third-party source - and not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5); the case should therefore be decided on the unimpaired trace as a monetary ruling rather than held open in escalation.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider, and to the driver: this is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.70. The charge stands except for the distance and time the driver was not entitled to bill.

1. Deviation established (POL-RD-01). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02852, weight 1.0) measures the trip at 14.4 km against the booked optimal of 9.0 km on the trip record (EV-TRIP-02852) — an excess of 5.4 km, 60.0% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km), and the excess is additionally a MATERIAL deviation (greater than 50%). The trace figure governs and the trip record agrees, so the threshold result is safe on either field.

2. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes (POL-RD-07). EV-GPS-02852 (weight 1.0) carries 114 fixes at a 10.0 s sample interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 s, so none of limbs (a)–(c) fires; the excess stands on the trace alone and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

3. The driver's explanation 'Road works' reduces nothing. No traffic advisory is on file: EV-ADVIS-02852-01 is MISSING, carries no payload and has weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. POL-RD-03 cannot be run — no advisory names a road or segment the optimal route traverses, none carries a validity window, and there is no shortest lawful alternative from which to derive a closure-adjusted optimal — so the excuse supplies no amended optimal and no reduction. Under POL-RD-08 an assertion citing no evidence id carries no weight and is discarded, and under POL-RD-13(1) an uncited traffic excuse is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation.

4. No other exculpation applies. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02852, weight 1.0) has 0 messages, so there was no rider instruction to create a detour (POL-RD-04 unavailable); pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null, so POL-RD-05 does not apply; vehicle_type is RYDE_X with solo_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-12 does not apply; and fare_model is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so the POL-RD-02 recomputation, not POL-RD-11, governs. No driver compensation arises: the rider was billed the same 14.4 km the trace records, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall.

5. The refund is arithmetic (POL-RD-02). recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 × 9.0 km optimal + 0.28 × 13.0 optimal minutes) × surge_multiplier 1.0, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-02852 and nowhere else, plus the 0.80 platform fee = 14.19 + 0.80 = 14.99. charged_total is 20.66, so the refund is 20.66 − 14.99 = 5.67, rounded UP to SGD 5.70 payable. That clears the 0.50 de minimis floor and is 27.4% of the charge, far short of the 90% share that would convert this to a FULL_REFUND. Nothing is added on top (POL-RD-09): there are zero ERP lines, zero tolls and a 0.0 airport surcharge on a trip that neither originates at nor ends at an airport, so the single figure the rider recovers is 5.70.

6. The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check was triggered by the material deviation and finds no pattern: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 2 against completed_trips_90d of 180, below both the three-flag test and the 0.05-ratio test at the 40-trip floor. There is therefore no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c). The rider's profile was not used as a ground: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0, so the extra-corroboration proviso in POL-RD-08 is not engaged. Lifetime counters such as prior_deviation_flags are context only under POL-GEN-01 and were not used; the claim resting on them was discarded.

7. No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, trip identifiers match across trip record, trace and fare breakdown (TRP-02852), timestamps are consistent, the trace is unimpaired, the only uncited excuse is not a missing-artifact invocation, and the refund is below both the SGD 150.00 ceiling and charged_total. The amount of SGD 5.70 does not exceed the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically on issue, subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver. The GPS trace for TRP-02852 (EV-GPS-02852, weight 1.0) measures the trip at 14.4 km against the booked optimal of 9.0 km on the trip record (EV-TRIP-02852, weight 1.0) — an excess of 5.4 km, 60% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 tests pass (more than 20% of optimal and more than 0.8 km absolute), so the deviation is established, and at over 50% it is material. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 114 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 s, so POL-RD-07(a)-(c) do not fire and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged; the excess may rest on the trace alone. Nothing is excluded before the threshold: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02852) is empty, so POL-RD-04 has no rider instruction to read; no endpoint was amended (pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null), so POL-RD-05 does not run; and the vehicle was RYDE_X, not a pooled trip, so POL-RD-12 does not apply and the 9.0 km booked optimal stands as the baseline.

The driver's explanation 'Road works' is tested against the traffic advisory for this trip and there is none: EV-ADVIS-02852-01 is MISSING, has no payload, and carries weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Under POL-RD-13 that assertion is discarded, carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal; because the driver's statement names no advisory identifier, this is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction, so the case is decided on the unimpaired trace and is not held open. The ruling records that the traffic assertion was discarded and that no advisory was on file.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, and the fare model is METERED. Stated on separate lines as the clause requires: charged_total = 20.66; recomputed_fare = (3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 9.0 km + 0.28 x 13.0 min) x surge_multiplier 1.0, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-02852 and nowhere else, plus the 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP or toll, no fixed surcharge, no waiting-time fee and no promo discount = 14.99; refund = 20.66 - 14.99 = 5.67, rounded up to SGD 5.70 payable. That is above the 0.50 de minimis floor but only 27.4% of charged_total, far short of the 90% share that would convert it to a full refund, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.70. Nothing is added on top of that figure: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00, off_optimal_route_total is 0.00 and no airport or other fixed surcharge applies, so POL-RD-09 adds no pass-through correction under (2) and no billing-integrity refund under (4), and (1) forbids stacking ERP onto the POL-RD-02 amount.

The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check was run because the deviation is material: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 2 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 180 (ratio 0.011), below both the three-flag test and the 5%-at-40-trips test, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established. No POL-RD-06(b) uplift to a full refund is available to the rider and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises; the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is not the trailing-90-day figure the clause asks for and was not used.

Confidence: the deciding facts — the trace distance, the optimal distance and the fare figures — are carried by artifacts at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0; the missing advisory carries no deciding fact and does not lower it, which keeps confidence above the 0.70 floor and POL-RD-10(1) unengaged. The monetary effect of 5.70 is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of 8.00, so it executes automatically. This is a provisional ruling made without human review, and either party may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

Both sides agree on the facts and the arithmetic, and the record supports them.

THE DEVIATION (rider's POL-RD-01 claim, and the driver does not contest it). The GPS trace, EV-GPS-02852, measures the trip at 14.4 km against the booked optimal of 9.0 km on the trip record, EV-TRIP-02852. That is an excess of 5.4 km, or 60.0% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED; because the excess also exceeds 50% of optimal it is additionally a MATERIAL deviation. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 114 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 s, so no corroboration beyond the trace is required and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

THE DRIVER'S 'ROAD WORKS' EXPLANATION. Tested under POL-RD-13 against the traffic advisory and nothing else, it fails for want of any advisory to test. This is also not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation: an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be an exculpatory clause invoked against one, and POL-RD-13(1) makes the absent advisory a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it.

DRIVER PROFILE CHECK (POL-RD-06). Both advocates ran it and I agree. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 2 against completed_trips_90d of 180 — below the 3-flag threshold and a ratio of 1.1%, far below the 5% test at the 40-trip floor. No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c). Materiality rests on this trip's own trace, not on the profile.

THE MONEY (POL-RD-02). The fare model is METERED. Stated on separate lines: charged_total = 20.66. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 × 9.0 optimal km + 0.28 × 13.0 optimal minutes) × the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-02852 and nowhere else, + 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP, no toll, no fixed surcharge, no waiting-time fee and no promo discount = 14.19 + 0.80 = 14.99. Refund = 20.66 − 14.99 = 5.67, rounded UP to 5.70. That is above the 0.50 de minimis floor and 27.4% of the charge, well short of the 90% share that would convert it to a full refund. So PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.70.

NO OTHER LIMB ADDS ANYTHING. The chat log, EV-CHAT-02852, is empty (0 messages), so POL-RD-04 excludes no distance; neither endpoint was amended and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 does not apply; the vehicle is RYDE_X and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-12's pooled baseline does not apply; and erp_gantries is empty with no tolls and no airport surcharge, so POL-RD-09 adds no pass-through correction and no billing-integrity referral. No driver compensation is payable: the fare was billed for the same 14.4 km the trace records, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall under POL-RD-04.

DISCARDED REASONING. The separate claim reasoning from driver_profile.prior_deviation_flags (lifetime 4) was discarded at the mechanical stage under POL-GEN-01. It is a context-only near-synonym of the trailing-90-day counter the clause names, and reputation is not a ground of decision on this trip.

What happens next: the monetary effect, SGD 5.70, does not exceed the SGD 8.00 POL-GEN-05 execution threshold, so it executes automatically. This is a provisional ruling made without human review, and either party may appeal it once under POL-GEN-04.
